blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Police are investigating the death of a 56-year-old bank department manager whose body was found inside a parked vehicle along Kennon Road between Barangays Camp 3 and Twinpeaks in the Benguet town of Tuba on Tuesday. Responding police officers, Scene of the Crime Operatives, and barangay health workers found the victim seated in the front passenger seat with a gunshot wound to the head. An unnumbered .22-caliber revolver was recovered at the scene.
